name: What is Level 5 drywall finishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Level 5 drywall finishing is the highest standard of drywall preparation, resulting in a smooth, uniform surface. It involves applying a very thin skim coat of joint compound over the entire surface of the drywall, after all joints and fasteners have been taped and mudded. This comprehensive skim coat minimizes surface imperfections and creates a monolithic appearance, making it ideal for critical lighting conditions, dark paints, or high-gloss finishes where any imperfection would be highly visible.
acceptedAnswer.description: Level 5 drywall finishing is the highest standard, involving a full skim coat over all drywall surfaces for a perfectly smooth, uniform appearance.
